Color Match Game

The Stroop color challenge — a color word appears in a mismatched ink color. Tap the button matching the INK color, not the word, against the clock.

Match the INK color, not the word!

📖 How to use

  1. Press Start — a color word appears in a mismatched color.
  2. Tap the button for the INK color (ignore the word).
  3. +1 for correct, −1 for wrong. 45 seconds on the clock.
  4. Beat your best score.

❓ Frequently asked questions

What am I supposed to match?

You must tap the button matching the color of the ink the word is written in — not what the word says. That conflict is the famous Stroop effect.

How is it scored?

You get 45 seconds. +1 for each correct tap, −1 for each wrong one.

Is my high score saved?

Your best score is saved in this browser.

Does it work on mobile?

Yes — big touch-friendly buttons.
